save_dir_path = "/scratch/n/N.Pfaffenzeller/nikolas_nethive/nethive_multiverse/thesis_plots"

runname = basename(run_path)
foldername = basename(dirname(dirname(run_path)))

ir = config.interaction_rate[1]

save(joinpath(save_path, "$(name).pdf"), fig)
save(joinpath(save_path, "$(name).png"), fig)
